spec: When isDirty() throws in packages/consensus-fix/bin/consensus-fix.mjs (outside a git repo or when git is unavailable) and --allow-dirty was not passed, set dirtyCheckSkipped = true, emit a loud WARNING to stderr (and in formatReport), and surface summary.dirtyCheckSkipped in formatJson (--json). Update packages/consensus-fix/README.md to document dirtyCheckSkipped and qualify the Dirty-tree guard safety guarantee. Add unit and CLI tests in packages/consensus-fix/test/format.test.mjs and packages/consensus-fix/test/bin.test.mjs.
title: consensus-fix: warn and surface dirtyCheckSkipped when dirty-tree guard cannot run (#601)
